results.title: Circular economy tests material mastery and consumers' willingness to pay
results.description: The EU's Packaging and Packaging Waste Regulation (PPWR, Regulation (EU) 2025/40) has been in force since Aug. 12, 2026, underscoring the rising importance of circular materials as sustainability pressures intensify. Hsu Hsiang-jui, deputy general manager of the Plastic Industry Development Center, said the circular economy is driving five major trends: reduction and recycling, reuse, mechanical recycling, chemical recycling and circular materials.

results.title: Spikes Asia to evolve into LIONS Asia as part of global overhaul
results.description: LIONS, the organisation behind Cannes Lions, Effie, WARC and Contagious, is evolving its global model with regional platforms across North America, Asia-Pacific (APAC) and the Middle East and North Africa (MENA). The platforms are aimed at providing creative and marketing communities with year-round access to LIONS’ intelligence, learning programmes, industry benchmarks and global networks, with programming adapted to individual markets. Cannes Lions will remain the centre of the LIONS ecosystem and its global benchmark for creative excellence, while the new regional platforms will provide access to LIONS’ programmes and expertise throughout the year. In North America, LIONS will launch Insight to Impact in Denver in October 2026 before moving to Nashville in 2027. The platform will bring together Informa’s TMRE: The Market Research Event and Content Marketing World with expertise from LIONS, including WARC, Contagious and Effie. From 2027, VidCon x LIONS Creators will become part of the Insight to Impact Festival. VidCon, described by LIONS as the world’s largest celebration of digital culture and creators, is joining the LIONS family. Spikes Asia to become LIONS Asia In APAC, Spikes Asia will evolve into LIONS Asia in September 2027, continuing its partnership with Haymarket Asia. The platform will feature the Asia Lions Awards and combine Spikes Asia’s regional presence with LIONS’ intelligence, learning and community programmes. LIONS Riyadh planned for 2027 In MENA, LIONS Riyadh will launch in December 2027 in partnership with Tahaluf and the Ministry of Media. The platform will provide access to LIONS’ global benchmarks, intelligence and learning programmes for the local creative and marketing community. LIONS also plans to establish a strategic alliance with Athar, run by its partner Motivate Media Group, alongside its existing Dubai Lynx partnership. Simon Cook, CEO, LIONS, said the new model is intended to make the organisation’s resources more accessible to creative and marketing professionals in different markets. “We’re evolving our global model to make more of what LIONS knows is useful closer to where people work, while keeping Cannes Lions as the place where the world comes together,” he said. The regional platforms will also feed local talent, work and perspectives back into the global LIONS ecosystem, according to the organisation. Thea Skelton, SVP, LIONS Festivals, said the organisation would work with local partners and creative communities to determine the programmes most relevant to each market. “It is not our intention to replicate Cannes Lions around the world. It’s about making LIONS more useful throughout the year and creating stronger connections between regional communities and the global stage,” she said. The regional model will extend beyond festivals and awards. LIONS already runs programmes including Brand Marketer Academy programmes in North America, CMO Accelerator City Editions across five cities and See It Be It Connect programmes globally. Further details on programming, participation and partnerships for each regional platform will be announced with local partners. The Cannes Lions International Festival of Creativity will return in June 2027 for its 74th edition.

results.title: Defence stock in focus as firm receives transfer of tech for precision-guidance system, check share price
results.description: Shares of the Hyderabad-based defence and aerospace technology company Apollo Micro Systems will be on investors' radar as the company has informed exchanges that it has received the Transfer of Technology (ToT) for the Semi-Active Laser Homing System (SALHS), which is a precision-guidance system designed to provide in-flight guidance to munitions towards a laser-designated target. It is an important development as the Ministry of Defence has already granted the Acceptance of Necessity (AoN) for the Multi Influence Ground Mine (MIGM) - Vighana. The development solidifies the company's transition into a Tier-I Original Equipment Design Cum Manufacturer (OEDM).

results.title: EU Flexibility Markets: What BESS Developers and Investors Need to Know
results.description: European electricity markets are placing greater emphasis on reliable capacity as renewable penetration increases. Electricity demand is also changing as transport, heating, industry, and data infrastructure become increasingly electrified.
